input.code:
bot.chat('Alright, found a clean flat spot. Starting a cozy wooden house here!')
const mats = [
  ['oak_planks', 64],
  ['oak_log', 64],
  ['glass', 32],
  ['oak_stairs', 64],
  ['oak_door', 1],
  ['torch', 8],
  ['red_bed', 1],
  ['chest', 1],
  ['crafting_table', 1],
]
for (let i = 0; i < mats.length; i++) {
  const [name, count] = mats[i]
  const id = mcData.itemsByName[name]?.id
  if (!id) { print(`missing item: ${name}`); continue }
  await bot.creative.setInventorySlot(36 + i, new Item(id, count))
}
bot.creative.startFlying()
print('hotbar stocked, flying')

const base = new Vec3(3, -60, 7)
bot.creative.startFlying()
bot.pathfinder.setMovements(new Movements(bot))
print(`before: ${bot.entity.position}`)
const res = await Promise.race([
  bot.pathfinder.goto(new goals.GoalNear(base.x, base.y, base.z, 2)).then(() => 'goto-done'),
  sleep(6000).then(() => 'timeout'),
])
print(`goto result: ${res}`)
print(`after: ${bot.entity.position}`)
